text: ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රයඅති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

THE Governor of Sabaragamuwa Province, in the series of ''Regulations relating to the preparation of plans and publication of notices indicating the names of roads and narrow roads maintained by the Pradeshiya Sabha in the Sabaragamuwa Province'' notified in the Special Gazette No. 2316/20 and dated 24th January 2022, and the order issued under Section 24 (I) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, and included in the notification published in the Gazette No.2427/30, dated Friday, 14th March 2025, included in the Schedule of Roads and Narrow Roads deemed to belong to the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha, It is hereby published for the information of the public that all roads and narrow roads which are deemed to belong to the Pradeshiya Sabha as per the orders passed by the aforesaid Court and which have not been sued in court before the date mentioned in the above notification and all roads and narrow roads which are deemed to belong to the Pradeshiya Sabha as per the orders passed by the aforesaid Court and which have been sued in court before the said dates shall be deemed to belong to the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha under the Resolution No. 06-02 of the General Assembly held on 11th September 2025.

It is further declared that the list of the above roads and narrow roads is included in the Schedule hereto and every road and narrow road included therein shall be deemed to be roads and narrow roads belonging to the Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha under sub-section (5) of section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act. Gama Ethige Ariyadasa, Chairman, Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha. Balangoda Pradeshiya Sabha,11th of September, 2025.
